statement: AMCU states that on 2026-07-16 it found TOV Nova Interpraiz and TOV Torhova Trubna Kompaniia responsible for bid-rigging in two 2025 barite tenders; the official register identifies decision 535-р.
The published AMCU case scope names case 145-26.13/35-26 and Prozorro tenders UA-2025-02-03-015471-a and UA-2025-03-17-004896-a.
Company IDs 35341905 and 45333199 appear as bidders in both official Prozorro records; the records contain five and four bidders respectively.
The official API expected values are 178530840.00 UAH and 157960871.70 UAH, VAT included.
The AMCU news item presents the combined expected value as 336491711 UAH with VAT.
For 11283 tonnes in UA-2025-03-17-004896-a, company 35341905 bid 144298287.00 UAH and company 37351098 bid 144309570.00 UAH, an exact difference of 11283.00 UAH or 1.00 UAH per tonne.
The document hashes exposed by the official API have an empty cross-company intersection for respondent IDs 35341905 and 45333199 in both tenders.
